subject: toeic
source_type: 독창적 비공식 TOEIC 연습문제; 공식 기출 아님
passage:
To: Project team
From: Mina Park, Operations
Subject: Revised maintenance window

The network maintenance originally planned for Thursday evening has been moved to Friday, 8:00–9:30 P.M. The vendor needs an additional day to test the replacement switch. No action is required from team members, but please save your work before leaving on Friday. I will send a completion notice after access is restored.
prompt: What is the main purpose of the email?
choices: To announce a change to a scheduled maintenance period
To ask the team to test a replacement switch
To report that access has already been restored
To request work on Thursday evening
explanation: The sender announces that maintenance moved from Thursday to Friday and explains the change.
quick_solution: The sender announces that maintenance moved from Thursday to Friday and explains the change.
